method: Historical mechanical coho replay using St. Joseph River at Niles, MI USGS 04101500 daily mean discharge, St. Joseph River at Niles, MI — measured water temperature USGS 04101500 daily mean measured water temperature, and each four-hour block's Open-Meteo radiation, cloud cover, and precipitation. The read is scoped to Measured river conditions describe the St. Joseph mainstem at Niles. Water temperature, clarity, hydraulic shape, and presentation conditions can differ in the harbor and lower Michigan river, at individual ladder tailwaters, and through South Bend, Mishawaka, and the Twin Branch reach. It validates scoring behavior and copy, not catch rates.
